history.name: The Bulldog
history.shared_categories: American (Traditional), Bars, Food, Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants

text.text_excerpt: Great bartenders. A total local place that welcomes everyone. Their kitchen is small but pulled pork quesadillas are amazing. Great back patio and their upstairs did be up and running soon. Great specials daily. Best drink deals in town. Ya gotta get here!

This is my new go-to spot for drinks AND music. How am I just discovering South Market?! The drinks are very cheap and strong, but even better, they have a late night happy hour that's I believe 9-12, and as far as I know that's pretty much unheard of. Also, the bartender Korey is so sweet and plays the best music...it's actually very hard to find a bar in NOLA that plays good and consistent "today's rap/hip hop" type music. I've been on both weeknights and weekends, and I've had equally good times. They have an upstairs with additional sofa type seating, a pool table, a balcony, a photo booth, and a juke box. It can get quite warm and humid inside (it's an old NOLA building and they keep...

Super cool bar! Really great staff (shoutout to Cory my fave bartender). It's a really nice, chill atmosphere. They had me at late night happy hour. The drinks are already reasonably priced but then they knock them down to half priced doubles. Upstairs has pool tables and a jukebox. The jukebox has a free photo booth on it, which my friend and I took advantage of. You take the pictures and pick the format then they email them to you. Downstairs the music is always good. They have pretty good food and a resident mannequin. Their watermelon daiquiri that is labeled "Go fxck yourself" is dangerous and will sneak up on you, I can attest to that lol.
